name: make
description: Connect Make to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Make MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Make to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with visual workflow automation using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Make workspace.
Find anything in Make that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review visual workflow automation in Make.
